tagline: Cosmeceutical science from 20 years of medical aesthetics
descriptor: CETERA by JCOSLAB Co., Ltd. — a Korean professional-care brand built on PDRN and exosome formulas for skin recovery and barrier care
about: JCOSLAB Co., Ltd. is a Korean company behind the premium cosmeceutical brand CETERA. According to the company, its formulations draw on more than 20 years of experience in medical aesthetics and dermatological science; the team describes its approach as "nothing more, nothing less — true functionality with only what's essential."

Most formulas use Centella Asiatica extract instead of purified water as their base, which, according to the company, improves moisturizing performance and reduces skin irritation. On that base the brand builds formulas with PDRN and exosomes, ingredients the company links to skin regeneration, cell-to-cell signaling, and strengthening the skin's protective barrier.

According to the company, CETERA is present in dermatology and plastic surgery clinics in the Gangnam area of Seoul, as well as in Shinsegae Duty Free and Dongwha Duty Free stores. The brand also offers customers personalized skin-care consultations.

In a reply dated 2026-11-11, the company confirmed interest in expanding to Latin America and agreed in principle to the creation and publication of a CETERA company and product profile on the Teranova Group platform, asking that it be built from the official materials it provides.
facts: JCOSLAB Co., Ltd., Korea; brand CETERA — "Premium K-Beauty Cosmeceutical"

lines.name: THETHERAPY — regenerating cushion
lines.note: A cushion built on PDRN and exosomes. According to the company, it gives long-lasting coverage without caking or darkening, intended for all-day and overnight skin care and recovery.

lines.name: ONEDROPP — ampoule
lines.note: An ampoule combining exosomes and PDRN. According to the company, it works on brightening, antioxidant protection, and barrier strengthening, with fast absorption.

lines.name: TERADROP — mask pack
lines.note: A concentrated mask with exosomes and PDRN. According to the company, it is used for soothing and regenerating the skin, including pre- and post-treatment care after dermatological procedures.

lines.name: SOLARTONING — SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen
lines.note: A PDRN and exosome complex in a triple-function formula. According to the company, it combines UVA/UVB protection, a calming effect without eye irritation, and a natural tone-up.

lines.name: MILKENCREME — cleansing milk
lines.note: A cleansing milk built on a triple hyaluronic acid complex. According to the company, it gently removes makeup, balances moisture, and leaves no tightness after cleansing.

lines.name: BRIENO — foam cleanser
lines.note: A gel-type cleanser with a weakly acidic formula close to the skin's own pH. According to the company, it produces a fine, dense foam and does not leave skin dry after washing.

lines.name: RETONIQUE — toner
lines.note: A toner built on bottled water rather than purified water, with ampoule-like functions. According to the company, it absorbs quickly and has a soothing, restorative effect.

lines.name: LOPLEMIXO — ampoule lotion
lines.note: A lotion with ampoule-like properties on the same base. According to the company, it strengthens moisture balance and immediate absorption of active ingredients.

lines.name: CEMEDIC GEL — SOS gel mask
lines.note: An emergency-care gel. According to the company, it is used to repair damaged skin and strengthen the barrier, with a strong soothing effect.

lines.name: HYALEXO — balance cream
lines.note: A barrier-care cream. According to the company, it locks in moisture and minerals and helps skin withstand harsh environments and moisture loss.

lines.name: CERADERMA — nourishing recovery cream
lines.note: A cream for barrier recovery. According to the company, it delivers minerals and moisture together to support skin under demanding external conditions.

tech.name: PDRN and exosomes
tech.note: According to the company, PDRN promotes collagen and extracellular matrix production, reduces excess sebum secretion, and improves skin texture; plant-derived exosomes support cell-to-cell signaling, delivering beneficial ingredients between skin cells.

tech.name: Centella Asiatica base
tech.note: According to the company, formulas use Centella Asiatica extract instead of purified water as their base, improving moisturizing performance and reducing the risk of skin irritation.

tech.name: Multi-hyaluronic acid complex
tech.note: According to the company, the formula holds a significant amount of water per gram, forming a protective layer on the skin's surface, enhancing hydration and supporting cell regeneration.

formats: Cleansing milk, foam cleansers and toners
